column3: EXAM MARKED: Youdecide WON at 8/13F by 7.5L — most-likely CORRECT (twin gauge: winner named) AND the pass CORRECT under law #16 (8/13 needs 62% strike; the penalty ate the visible edge; no value existed); danger Edgewell only 3rd beaten 34L — his 7lb swing bought nothing
column4: CALIBRATION: the odds-on bar worked exactly as designed — right horse + wrong price = named pass and both halves are wins for the record; secondary lesson: in a field of cripples the sum BETWEEN cripples means little (Edgewell) — the only live horse means everything and the market knows it (that is WHY he was 8/13)
column5: LESSON: discipline held at odds-on one night after Gore Point — the same shape that cost 2pt yesterday cost 0 today
